clock._note: real_time: in normal play (and live) the world's day and night follow the real clock at utc_offset_h (the developer's own time, never named in speech); tests keep the game clock unless --real-clock. --clock-hour=H starts the real clock at hour H.

ritual_sanctuary.name: Ritual Sanctuary
ritual_sanctuary.description: Engraved arcane circle on a stepped dais, spell altar, fluted colonnade and ruins.

mage_training_grounds.name: Mage Training Grounds
mage_training_grounds.description: Ring of standing stones east of the sanctuary for casting practice and future mentor lessons.

ancient_spell_library.name: Ancient Spell Library
ancient_spell_library.description: Vaulted underground library beneath the west ruins: shelves, reading desks, a spell lectern.

mentors_tower.name: Mentor's Tower
mentors_tower.description: Stone tower on a rise with an external stair, lookout balcony and an advanced-magic circle.

ancient_grove.name: Ancient Grove
ancient_grove.description: Immense moss-hung trees around overgrown stones and a fallen giant.

forgotten_forest_shrine.name: Forgotten Forest Shrine
forgotten_forest_shrine.description: Runic ruin with carved guardian faces, a stair and glowing glyph stones.

luminous_river.name: Luminous River
luminous_river.description: A clear river with glowing reeds and stepping stones through the valley floor.

waterfall_crossing.name: Waterfall Crossing
waterfall_crossing.description: An arched stone bridge in front of twin waterfalls and spray.

village_square.name: Village Square
village_square.description: Timber-and-slate houses around a cobbled square with a stone well.

lantern_market.name: Lantern Market
lantern_market.description: A lane of market stalls under strings of lanterns.

craft_workshop.name: Craft Workshop
craft_workshop.description: Open-fronted workshop with workbench, tools, barrels and an alchemy table.

village_observatory.name: Village Observatory
village_observatory.description: Hilltop star platform with a brass telescope overlooking the village.

crystal_entrance.name: Crystal Entrance
crystal_entrance.description: A rocky cave mouth where the first crystals glow in the dark.

luminous_crystal_hall.name: Luminous Crystal Hall
luminous_crystal_hall.description: A high chamber of giant glowing crystal formations.

underground_lake.name: Underground Lake
underground_lake.description: A still subterranean lake with a crystal-lit shoreline.

ancient_vault.name: Ancient Vault
ancient_vault.description: Sealed stone vault with a monumental door and a glowing seal.

mountain_path.name: Mountain Path
mountain_path.description: Switchback trail climbing steep slopes with cairns and long views.

cliff_overlook.name: Cliff Overlook
cliff_overlook.description: Railed stone overlook above the cloud sea and distant peaks.

celestial_observatory.name: Celestial Observatory
celestial_observatory.description: Armillary sphere and star dial on the summit under an extraordinary sky.

cloud_temple.name: Cloud Temple
cloud_temple.description: Tiered stone temple at the edge of the sea of clouds.

academy_courtyard.name: Academy Courtyard
academy_courtyard.description: Monumental courtyard framed by the academy's halls and spires.

great_library.name: Great Library
great_library.description: Tall interior of bookcases, galleries, study tables and chandeliers.

advanced_magic_arena.name: Advanced Magic Arena
advanced_magic_arena.description: Circular arena with tiered stone seating for large-scale magic.

academy_gardens.name: Academy Gardens
academy_gardens.description: Formal gardens with hedges, flowerbeds and a fountain.

whispering_woods.name: Whispering Woods
whispering_woods.description: The Sanctuary's wild hinterland: a winding forest trail, a hidden lotus pond, an old stone bridge over the river below a waterfall, forgotten ruins on the high ground, a creature den across the river and the frontier road north-west.

connections: forest path through the north arch
stairway down beneath the west ruins
east trail past the training stones
ley-line portal (magical, only between the two schools of magic)

connections.why: the ley-line gate between the two schools has lain dormant for centuries; opening it is spatial magic no living student has mastered (see docs/WORLD_TRAVEL.md: teleportation is a discipline to be discovered, not a given)

connections: forest track down to the river
quarry road to the cave mouth
the frontier road over the north-west ridge

sunken_citadel.name: Sunken Citadel
sunken_citadel.note: Visible ruin across the southern marsh. Planned destination; no playable scene exists yet.

crystal_vale.name: The Crystal Vale
crystal_vale.note: East of the Sanctuary toward the Crystal Caverns' hills: a valley of giant violet crystal spires, seen from the Whispering Woods' high ground. Scenic landmark only; no playable scene exists yet.
